name: unapproved baseline v0 (exception lists)
note: Not approved: no approver is named in docs/guardrails.md section 10 (D-05). Every exception list the checks use, recorded by key and SHA-256 (figure lists by hash only). Against it, an entry added to an allow list, changed in one, or removed from a deny list is a loosening that fails the loosening check. Written by tools/checks/loosening/write-baseline.ts, which refuses any loosening.

checks.default-ignores.source: tools/checks/lib.ts: DEFAULT_IGNORES (paths every scanning check skips)

checks.roster.source: the checks an exception list can belong to: tools/checks/runner.ts EXPECTED_CHECKS, the tools eslint, depcruise, vitest, checks, and each rule of tools/eslint-rules/index.js as eslint:<rule>

company-figures.source: tools/checks/company-figures.txt (company figures and SAUTER names; stored by hash)

fixture-manifest.never-read.source: tools/checks/fixture-manifest/manifest.ts: NEVER_READ (paths the document scan never reads)

index.reviewed-test-doubles.source: tools/checks/index/reviewed-test-doubles.json: entries (test doubles a guardrail case file or support module may use)

tests/guardrails/_support/property.ts.widening: Recorded in phase 1 inside a new allow list, which the writer then counted as a tightening. At 135d74d only the pending wrapper could catch the stub's error, so this exemption from the index check's [support] rule widens a check the phase 0 baseline already had (phase 1 review, verifier finding 3). Re-recorded as a widening waiting for the approver; nothing approves it (D-05).
